files.module_doc:
UnaMentisTests
Comprehensive unit tests for linguistic matching (lemmatization)
Target: 30+ test cases using Apple Natural Language framework

UnaMentisTests
Comprehensive unit tests for n-gram similarity matching
Target: 50+ test cases covering transpositions, spelling errors, variations

UnaMentisTests
Comprehensive unit tests for phonetic matching (Double Metaphone)
Target: 50+ test cases covering person names, places, scientific terms

UnaMentisTests
Comprehensive unit tests for the Knowledge Bowl synonym bundle.
Target: 100+ test cases covering places, scientific, historical, mathematics.
After Phase 4, the KB synonym dictionaries live on the host SynonymResource
(SynonymResource.knowledgeBowl) supplied by the strictness profile, and the
matching is category-scoped by AnswerCategory. These tests exercise that
moved bundle directly.

UnaMentisTests
Comprehensive unit tests for token-based similarity (Jaccard & Dice)
Target: 50+ test cases covering word order, extra/missing words
